text: Sorry if this is nothing. I'm a childminder and have a 4 year old boy with me overnight. He's at 38.2. He's got some little dark red dots on his tummy and legs, and I pressed a glass on them like you're meant to and they didn't go away. Also I've just realised he hasn't had a wee since this morning, so it's been over 12 hours. I don't want to overreact but I'm not his mum so wanted to check what I should do
